before: Pipeline carries gas to an exporting LNG terminal
after: yes when a source ties this pipeline, segment, or expansion to LNG export: it delivers gas into an LNG export terminal, carries feedgas toward one (including upstream supply lines), or has an LNG exporter as a named shipper or reason for the project. Export terminals in Mexico that take US gas count. Blank otherwise, never no. A pipeline tied only to an import terminal stays blank and names the terminal in AssociatedLNGTerminal.
